content_sections.heading: Visva Bharati Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 5 vacancies are available – 3 for Field Investigator, 1 for Research Assistant, and 1 for Research Associate.

content_sections.heading: Visva Bharati Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Field Investigator: Postgraduate with at least 55% marks in Social Sciences, Humanities, Performing Arts, Music, Cultural Studies, History, Sociology, Anthropology, Education, Folklore, Heritage Studies, or allied disciplines. Ability to undertake field surveys, interviews, documentation, and data collection. Research Assistant: Postgraduate with at least 55% marks in Social Sciences, Humanities, Performing Arts, Music, Education, Cultural Studies, History, Sociology, Anthropology, or allied disciplines along with NET/M.Phil/Ph.D. Knowledge of research methodology, field survey, documentation, and report writing. Research Associate: Ph.D. or NET/M.Phil./Postgraduate with at least 55% marks in Social Sciences, Humanities, Performing Arts, Cultural Studies, Education, History, Sociology, Anthropology, Music, or allied disciplines with at least 2 years of research experience as research assistant in a project. Evidence of research experience, publications, and academic writing.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Visva Bharati Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 14-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Visva Bharati Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Visva Bharati Recruitment 2026 is 14th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies available for the Field Investigator post in the Visva Bharati Recruitment 2026. This is a significant opportunity for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum educational qualification required for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: For the Research Associate position, candidates must have a Ph.D. or NET/M.Phil./Postgraduate with at least 55% marks and a minimum of 2 years of research experience as a research assistant.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this Visva Bharati recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The mode of application for the Visva Bharati Recruitment 2026 is via email. Candidates need to send their applications to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What are the selection criteria for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Visva Bharati Recruitment 2026 involves shortlisting of applications followed by an interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q7. Can candidates from outside West Bengal apply?
faq.answer: The notification specifies the location as Santiniketan, West Bengal. While not explicitly stated, candidates from outside West Bengal may apply if they meet all other eligibility criteria.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions of Field Investigator, Research Assistant, and Research Associate at Visva Bharati are on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should be attached with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates should attach self-attested copies of all required documents, including educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs, along with their bio-data.
